scripts.build:bin: bun run build:client && VERSION=$(bun -e "console.log(require('./package.json').version)") && bun build --compile --asset ../client/dist --define=PROKOPAI_VERSION="'${VERSION}'" --outfile=dist/bin/prokop src/cli.ts
scripts.build:bin:macos: bun run build:client && VERSION=$(bun -e "console.log(require('./package.json').version)") && bun build --compile --asset ../client/dist --define=PROKOPAI_VERSION="'${VERSION}'" --outfile=dist/bin/prokop-macos-arm64 src/cli.ts
scripts.build:bin:linux: bun run build:client && VERSION=$(bun -e "console.log(require('./package.json').version)") && bun build --compile --asset ../client/dist --define=PROKOPAI_VERSION="'${VERSION}'" --outfile=dist/bin/prokop-linux-x64 src/cli.ts
scripts.build:bin:windows: bun run build:client && VERSION=$(bun -e "console.log(require('./package.json').version)") && bun build --compile --asset ../client/dist --define=PROKOPAI_VERSION="'${VERSION}'" --outfile=dist/bin/prokop-windows-x64.exe src/cli.ts
scripts.build:all: bun run build && bun run build:bin
